Internal intelligence — what is still bounded These are the measures a business of this kind is judged on that the public record did not supply. Each one is a magnitude the analysis above had to leave in direction only. revenue growth — the rate the contracted base is compounding at. large-customer growth — expansion inside big accounts is where this model's margin is. contracted backlog or remaining performance obligations — revenue already signed decides how much of next year is discretionary. gross margin — delivery cost per unit served is what turns growth into profit here. net revenue retention — whether the installed base grows without a new sale. sales efficiency — what it costs to add a unit of recurring revenue. What impossible hypothesis should we tes.text: Home · Your analyses · Guest demo session Leave demo Microsoft Corporation What impossible hypothesis should we test? Microsoft Corporation may be worth more serving materially fewer customers than it serves today.: Its customers are individual consumers, small and medium organizations, large global enterprises, public-sector institutions, service providers, application… — a population wide enough that the cost to serve almost certainly is not uniform across it. Where the dispersion is wide, a minority of accounts can carry the whole contribution and the remainder can consume it through support, delivery and churn.; The most valuable customer for what Microsoft Corporation has built may not be the customer it currently sells to.: The capability behind the product was built to serve individual consumers, small and medium organizations, large global enterprises, public-sector institutions, service providers, application…. Capabilities are rarely specific to the buyer they were built for, and an adjacent buyer with a more expensive underlying problem can be worth more per unit of the same delivered capability.; The workflow that Microsoft Corporation's product sits inside may stop existing rather than be improved.: It sells an array of services, including cloud-based solutions that provide customers with AI, software, services, platforms, and content, and it provide….
